uplift_rationale.cross_sell: Proactive outreach on a scored whitespace roughly doubles a low natural conversion rate; directional evidence: McKinsey reports next-best-action programmes in B2B distribution lifting bookings (mckinsey.com distribution blog).
uplift_rationale.upsell: Smaller lift: the partner already buys the category, so the natural rate is higher and outreach adds less.
uplift_rationale.solution: Bundling removes the coordination cost of buying from several divisions; one PO and one owner is the main lever.
uplift_rationale.recurring: Largest lift: annuity attach is near zero today because nobody owns the offer (Avaus: hardware buyers' next-best offer is usually the service); a zero-touch renewal playbook reaches every installed unit.

assumptions.method: treatment vs control-calibrated counterfactual on common random numbers

decision.message: Gross-profit uplift is positive at 90% confidence and annuity grows ≥25% — roll out to all branches.

gates.metric: ≥ 70% of routed opportunities accepted within SLA; ≥ 60% weekly active reps
gates.if_fail: Fix workflow fit (WhatsApp/ERP integration) before judging the model

gates.metric: Back-test precision@5 holds within 20% on live data; < 15% 'not relevant' feedback
gates.if_fail: Retrain with rep feedback labels; tighten thresholds
Narrow to the 2 best-performing solution templates

gates.metric: GP per account uplift > 0 at 90% confidence AND ARR uplift ≥ 25%
gates.if_fail: Stop: keep data unification + routing, retire recommendations
